notes.title: Softlocking Doors fixed
notes.content: [p]This isn't a big post, just letting you all know I [i]should have[/i] properly fixed the softlocking doors phenomenon. If it does happen again, I do ask you to contact me directly (through [url="https://discord.gg/B48BVMQzSJ"]my discord, [/url]using the [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12mqFjI5VhXZJW0OSdnKYK690-V1pUdIQDtDYrE9l2OM/edit"]Bug Report Form[/url] or through my email (akyrahaiato@gmail.com)). [/p][p][/p][p]Of course, if any glitches [i]unrelated[/i] to that come to happen, feel free to use the same sources! [/p][p][/p][p]I hope to continue fixing everything to make this demo, and the future game that will come of it, the best as I can. [/p][p][/p][p]Have a great day, and I'll see you in the next one![/p]

notes.title: Clarity Fixes and Feedback
notes.content: [p]Hey there! [/p][p]Making this post mainly to announce that a few clarity things have been fixed (I'm absolutely terrible with that, as you can see), and also, to announce we now have a discord and a google form you can fill out with any issues or comments you have! To the links, shall we? [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/B48BVMQzSJ" style="button"]Discord Server![/url][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeteKrQkSIKTuStJMlY4pzKdAAmDj6Zfl2kzno_xzbkqwdP4w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=109476297167659892002" style="button" buttoncolor="#3768fb"]Google Form![/url][/p][p]And if you have any interest in the fixes: [/p][list][*][p]Locked the door until you finish the tutorial (stop sneaking around people, please talk to the NPCs);[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust the conversation to avoid leaving before finishing it and diminishing confusion when talking to the NPC;[/p][/*][*][p]Added saves to door states (which I surprisingly forgot to do) [/p][/*][/list][p]That's basically it, they're some pretty small fixes, but I hope you all use the new tools available to let me know how's the game so far!! [/p][p]That's all for today, and I'll see you in the next one![/p]
